Load from Google Sheet (optional)

In your sheet: File → Share → Publish to web → select the price-log tab → CSV → Publish, then paste that link below. Expected column headers (any order, case-insensitive): Quotation No., PN, Item Name or Model, Description, Unit Price, VAT Mode (value EX or INC), QTY, UOM. Brand is optional — include it and it'll print on the quote automatically; leave a row's Brand blank and that line is simply skipped.
